name: Lean.Meta.DiscrTree.reduce

source.code:
/--
Reduction procedure for the discrimination tree indexing.
-/
partial def reduce (e : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let e ← whnfCore e
  match (← unfoldDefinition? e) with
  | some e => reduce e
  | none => match e.etaExpandedStrict? with
    | some e => reduce e
    | none   => return e
